# Evidence Note 20

A local-first design keeps cached evidence readable even when offline. Infrastructure built as a central service disappears when its funding does.

A large share of cited web content changes within a few years of publication. Hashing the normalized body makes the cache immune to advertising noise. Preserved versions let anyone recover the text as it was when cited. An honest client reports a refusal exactly as it was received.
